acceptance: 1) Caller/wiring point: real restricted handlers -> recovery-enrollment service. Encrypt pendingSecret on first entry; reentry within the original window returns the same URI/original expiresAt without rotation or extension. Wrong/expired/repeated confirms and two concurrent confirms check current token/sv/secret/step and commit at most once. The old valid method remains usable before a failing attempt (E-08, E-14). 2) After a real confirm with a new unused TOTP, publish secret/new recovery-code hashes, increment sv, revoke old devices/recovery credentials, consume the session, and clear the cookie in one transaction. Return recovery codes once. Change password simultaneously only for a SERVER_OWNER-preauthorized hash; HTTP accepts only totp. Unknown outcomes do not replay; actual ordinary sign-in at the next time step verifies the result. Old factors/devices reject (E-15).

E-08.scene: C-03 Authenticator enrollment and the passwordless-default toggle
E-08.trigger: An enrollment code is wrong or expired, a submission is repeated, or switches occur concurrently.
E-08.expect: Test all four triggers separately. In the final transaction, recheck the pending enrollment record, validity period, and current credential version. Do not commit wrong, expired, or replayed submissions; at most one of two concurrent switches succeeds. After a failure, querying the account must still show at least one verified sign-in method. Follow section 09 without inventing another sign-in method.

E-14.scene: C-04 Lost authenticator and single-administrator recovery
E-14.trigger: Recovery is interrupted or the reset credential expires.
E-14.expect: Explicitly reject protected admin access with restricted credentials. Interruption or expiry must not commit the pending new factor, and the original valid enrollment remains intact. A valid restricted cookie may re-enter the same enroll operation; once invalid, restart through the recovery-code or authorization path defined in section 10. Restricted credentials cannot be exchanged for a full admin session.

E-15.scene: C-04 Lost authenticator and single-administrator recovery
E-15.trigger: The new authenticator is verified and recovery is committed.
E-15.expect: Revoke the old sessions, old enrollment, and old recovery credentials. Generate new recovery codes and explicitly show them once; old devices cannot continue accessing the admin area afterward.
